projects.name: Job Market Crawler
projects.line: Polls ATS boards directly and ranks every posting deterministically before it spends a single model call.
projects.note: source: repo description and README; the 86% is the 304-not-modified share of all polls

projects.name: TrustMed
projects.line: Answers drug questions by traversing a medical knowledge graph instead of matching text against it.
projects.note: source: README, 354,029 concepts and 23M+ edges from the UMLS Level 0 subset

projects.name: ZK-ColdChain
projects.line: Proves a refrigerated shipment broke its temperature limit without revealing the temperature log, then pays out on the proof.
projects.note: source: README; 8°C is the circuit's constraint, Groth16 the generated verifier

projects.name: Maryland Crash Atlas
projects.line: Linked D3 views over public crash reports, where selecting in any chart filters the map with it.
projects.note: source: final.csv is 32,429 rows over 20 fields; five view types in index.html; Montgomery County crash reporting via data.gov

projects.name: Automated Warehouse
projects.line: Encodes multi-robot warehouse fulfilment as logic constraints and solves for plans where robots never collide.
projects.note: source: README; instances inst1-inst5, domain from the ASP Challenge 2019
